concepts.quote: the point uses pixels, so both are in the middle.
concepts.why: It uses the wrong rule that StdDraw.point(256, 256) draws in the middle; in the default unit square it is not visible.

concepts.quote: The square uses 0.5 as the centre
concepts.why: It correctly applies the rule that square(x, y, r) is centred on (x, y) to this call.
The answer says nothing about empty statements.
It assumes pixel coordinates, but the default scale is the unit square.
